svg.title: Where the outcome of a run goes
svg.desc: A run, scheduled, by hand or a dry-run, writes its report. The status of the app keeps the state, the times and the report of the last run, which the settings page shows at every visit, the errors first. The error of a document goes to the Nextcloud log as a warning when it first occurs or changes. A run that changed something, and every import that Paperless finished, failed or refused, adds an entry to the Activity stream of the target user, with links to the files, but a dry-run adds none. A mirror that keeps failing, and every import that failed or was refused, sends a notification, but a dry-run sends none.
